description: If \(p\) is nonprincipal over \(T\), \(\Gamma\) is any finite satisfiable condition in new names, and \(\bar c\) is a name tuple in the context of \(p\), then some original \(\varphi\in p\) can be made false at \(\bar c\) while retaining satisfiability of \(T+\Gamma\). Repeated names and empty tuples are allowed.
